g.title: columns
g.text: Five-column correspondence, one row per waypoint

Colours as in blueprint.pdf: dark green = machine-checked counterpart exact; light green = counterpart in different form; orange = refereed by a second model only; red = unrefereed. Lean column: dark green = declaration.
